content: Hello, I am Beacon Assurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?

Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Sure, it's zero zero six four one zero.
Could you please tell me your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I can't manage it today, but I can pay the full four hundred and eighty on October fifteenth, tomorrow.
To confirm: the motor premium, 480.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the four hundred and eighty for that Thursday.
Your promise is recorded: the motor premium, 480.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Your receipt will be sent by post. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks for your help.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
